````markdown
# Second-pass validation and bounded experiment design

Prepared 2026-10-02, starting at approximately 11:08 UTC / 07:08 America/Indianapolis. User-authorized deadline: **13:00 EDT / 17:00 UTC today**. Owner of this note: method-research agent. This pass read lightweight result/configuration JSON, existing research and selected source files; it did not load OOF prediction matrices, audit labels/scores or test predictions, launch training, change old artifacts, or submit anything.

## Evidence boundary and immutable reference

The v1 release has already been audited and its results exposed. **Exclude its original audit rows from every v2 exploratory fit, stopping decision, feature selection, calibration, blend selection and real-data smoke test. Do not re-score that audit to select v2.** Once recipes, lengths and blend weights are frozen, the project permits full-data production refits using all labels, including the original audit rows. Those refits must make no further selection or stopping decisions from the audit. The original audit and its previously documented unexposed subset are both historical v1 assessment evidence, not fresh v2 evaluation data. Project instructions now document 568 earlier smoke-exposed audit rows and the corresponding 69,396-row v1 sensitivity subset. This note did not read either score or inspect their labels. Preserve the exclusion manifest unchanged; no retrospective reassignment can create a new holdout.

Keep the existing 629,671 development rows, three outer folds and split hash `4e262277b0a1494cd5d26ff45a30c827480ef334974f1331d730df0a7c80075c`. Each model still gets an inner stopping split followed by an outer refit, with all fitted transformations scoped to the appropriate training rows. This produces honest row-level OOF predictions for a specified recipe, but **the recipe choices and weights remain adaptively selected on those same development labels** after 30 first-pass configurations and the additional v2 comparisons. Do not call v2 OOF an unbiased test result. A fresh random split of the already inspected development set does not undo that exposure.

Use `artifacts/blend/selection.json`, frozen **2026-10-02T04:02:37.697282+00:00**, as the immutable v1 selection reference. The second-pass config currently points to `artifacts/blend/frozen.json`; if the controller reads that file for its weights, ignore its audit fields and prohibit any audit-dependent branch. Prefer an explicit weights-only copy in the new campaign directory, without editing the original. The historical development anchor is:

- Pooled AUC **0.961221030185844**.
- Fold AUC **0.9607382225164004 / 0.9611571758234585 / 0.9617794511724912**.
- All original component weights, fixed two-seed group ratios, class mapping, native checkpoints and preprocessing remain frozen. Treat the whole v1 prediction as **one fixed candidate** rather than reopening its 30-model weight search.

Production v2 refits may use all training labels **after selection freeze**, with fixed round counts derived from development training and the frozen inference recipe. This changes the fitted function and provides no independent v2 evaluation. Development-trained fold predictions remain the verified fallback if refitting or native reload fails. New inference files and release manifests get a separate campaign path; preserve v1 as the working fallback. This paragraph corrects the initial note's overly restrictive production-refit prohibition.

## What the first pass establishes locally

These are development observations, not generalization claims:

| Comparison | Observed result | Implication |
|---|---|---|
| XGB TE+teacher plus train-only numeric distance profiles | AUC 0.96052108 -> 0.96067453; all three fold changes positive; 61 seconds total | Profiles are a concrete representation hypothesis, not merely a public-notebook lead. |
| CatBoost route+TE+teacher plus the same profiles | 0.96071452 -> 0.96071067; fold changes mixed; zero v1 blend weight | Profile transfer is family-dependent; do not assume it improves every learner. |
| Numerical RealMLP TE+teacher, 4 -> 16 epoch maximum | 0.96063332 -> 0.96037047; every fold declines; selected epochs 5/6/5; 539 seconds | More fit time alone is not the leading opportunity. The longer flat-anneal schedule also changes optimization dynamics. |
| Native RealMLP TE+teacher two seeds | 0.96062671 and 0.96073254; fixed average 0.96072288 | Keep equal seed averaging; do not select only the lucky seed. The first pass's fixed group contributes complementary errors. |
| Native TabM | Early overfitting at 2-4 epochs; PLE+TE has substantial fold-dependent output-scale drift | Defer larger TabM models, longer schedules and outer-OOF calibration. |
| LightGBM | Best existing teacher variant uses native distance categories, but no manual TE or numeric profiles; AUC 0.95944899, 38 seconds | The representation comparison remains incomplete. A matched TE/profile sequence is more informative than another leaf-count sweep. |

The first-pass macro-versus-pooled coarse blend comparison returned identical weights for 20 candidates. Preserve pooled AUC as the registered optimization objective, report mean/fold AUC as robustness diagnostics, and do not switch objectives post hoc to rescue a candidate.

## Twelve bounded experiment slots

Clone the named completed control's **recorded run configuration**, not mutable library defaults. Preserve its model seed, inner stopping split seed, outer folds, teacher, TE keys/seed and all unlisted settings. Assign a unique `v2_` ID. Every slot is a complete three-fold OOF experiment unless a genuine execution/resource failure prevents completion. Runtime estimates below use measured first-pass costs; caps are operational budgets, not predicted convergence. Do not fill unused slots with an unplanned sweep.

| Priority / suggested ID | Exact matched control and change | Failure mode being tested | Expected time / cap |
|---|---|---|---|
| 01 `v2_realmlp_cat_te_teacher_profiles` | Already queued: clone `realmlp_cat_te_teacher`; only `route_profiles=true` | Native category embeddings and TE may omit the service/passenger composition associated with a distance value | 5-8 min / 20 min |
| 02 `v2_lgb_route_te_teacher_127` | Clone `lgb_route_teacher_127`; add exactly the six-key encoding block used by `xgb_route_te_teacher`, smoothing 20, five inner folds, seed 20261001, counts true | LightGBM's native category splitting may fail to recover stable high-cardinality propensity summaries | 1-2 min / 5 min |
| 03 `v2_lgb_route_te_teacher_profiles_127` | Clone slot 02; only `route_profiles=true` | Label-free numeric composition may add a signal distinct from target propensity, completing a fair feature comparison across tree families | 1-3 min / 6 min |

| 07 `v2_realmlp_cat_te_teacher_lr0265` | Clone `realmlp_cat_te_teacher`; only `params.learning_rate=.0265` instead of .053; keep four-epoch budget | A large learning rate may leave unstable probabilities/embeddings at the short scheduled endpoint; a negative result can indicate insufficient optimization at the reduced rate | 5-7 min / 15 min |
| 08 `v2_realmlp_cat_te_teacher_emb10` | Clone `realmlp_cat_te_teacher`; only `params.embedding_size=10` instead of 5 | A five-dimensional distance embedding may constrain useful interaction structure; doubled embedding size tests that bottleneck without widening every hidden layer | 5-8 min / 15 min |
| 09 `v2_xgb_route_te_teacher_profiles_te100` | Clone `xgb_route_te_teacher_profiles`; only `encoding.smoothing=100` instead of 20 | Sparse composite-key target estimates may be too noisy or differ too much between cross-fitted training and full-map inference | 1-2 min / 5 min |
| 10 `v2_realmlp_cat_profiles_teacher_no_te` | Clone slot 01; remove its `encoding` block, retain profiles, numeric/category twins and teacher | Manual TE might become redundant or inject training/inference mismatch once native categories and profile means are available | 4-7 min / 15 min |
| 11 `v2_cat_route_te_teacher_dual_original` | Clone `cat_route_te_teacher`; append one separately saved **original-only LightGBM teacher probability**, retaining the existing XGB teacher | A single source-trained XGB supplies only one inductive prior; a leaf-wise source model might capture complementary original-domain structure | 3-6 min fitting/integration after setup / 15 min run; timebox new adapter work to 20 min |
| 12 `v2_<promoted_recipe>_confirm_seed20261021` | Conditional: one predetermined seed 20261021 replication of the strongest new candidate passing the gate below; form a fixed 50/50 pair | Verify that a promising change survives combined training-and-stopping variability; avoid opportunistic seed choice | Match measured candidate cost / 20 min |

Slots 01-10 are supported by the existing configuration interfaces. `embedding_size`, learning-rate and weight-decay aliases are accepted by the inspected native RealMLP wrapper. Slot 11 requires explicit ownership of a small new feature/teacher adapter and its tests; **it is a proposal, not implemented by this note**. If the adapter cannot be verified within its setup timebox, skip it rather than substituting ad hoc source predictions. Slots 06-08 deliberately compare with the original native RealMLP control, not a newly chosen winner, preventing a hidden hyperparameter/feature bundle. Slot 10 depends on slot 01's feature contract but should not change its other settings.

For slot 11, use only the existing cleaned 129,859-row original dataset and preserve its feature-only exact-overlap exclusions. A fixed practical teacher recipe is CPU LightGBM binary objective, 600 iterations, learning rate .05, 63 leaves, minimum child samples 50, L2 5, feature/bagging fractions .8, bagging frequency 1, four threads, seed 20261020. These values are a bounded hypothesis, not tuned source-validation optima. Fit its category dictionary on original data, never synthetic labels. Save it under a **new** teacher directory/file with keyed probabilities; do not replace `data/teacher_predictions.parquet`. Verify reload, IDs, positive class, finite probabilities and overlap exclusions before any synthetic model consumes it. Original labels are an allowed external prior, but near-duplicate ancestry and synthetic/source mismatch remain limitations.

Do not add an unrestricted second teacher tuning campaign, pseudo-labeling, deleting difficult labels, original-row concatenation, GPT/token-feature sweeps, TabPFN/foundation-model dependencies, unconstrained meta-learners or many new seeds. The first pass already established cheap competitive families; the highest remaining uncertainty concerns their representation and regularization, not access to a much larger architecture. The public source's teacher and profile ideas are documented in `competition_evidence.md`; their author scores are not acceptance criteria here.

## Promotion, robustness and v2 selection

Use the **existing second-pass policy**, recorded before these results, rather than inventing a significance claim:

1. For each completed candidate, report paired changes versus its matched control in pooled AUC, mean fold AUC, all three fold AUCs, selected lengths and wall time. A standalone improvement of at least 0.00005 in pooled and mean AUC, positive on at least two folds and with no fold below -0.00010, is useful evidence to prioritize follow-up. This is a practical information gate, not a p-value. Inferior standalone models may still pass the blend gate.
2. Compare only fixed-anchor mixtures `(1-alpha)*anchor + alpha*candidate` at the registered alpha grid **.05, .10, .20, .30**. Eligibility requires at least **0.00001 pooled gain**, **0.00001 mean-fold gain**, and **no fold regression worse than 0.00002**. These are tolerances for this campaign, not evidence that a ten-millionth or ten-thousandth change is statistically resolved. Log the full grid, including failures.
3. Keep the original v1 component weights and existing fixed seed groups locked. Add at most **three** new accepted candidates/groups by the registered constrained procedure. At each addition enforce the gate relative to the current anchored blend, and finally enforce it against the original v1 anchor too. Do not reopen zero-weight v1 candidates as free parameters or independently tune the members of a seed pair.
4. Slot 12 is permitted only when a new candidate has a fixed-anchor pooled and mean gain of at least **0.00003**, with all three fold changes nonnegative at the same alpha. Predeclare the seed before fitting; assess the equal average, not whichever seed is larger. The current trainer couples the seed to the inner stopping split, so this estimates training-plus-stopping variability. Do not repeat until one seed wins. Require the equal-average group to pass the ordinary blend gate before using it.
5. Preserve all three folds in the final report. Inspect candidate mean probabilities, log loss/Brier and fold AUC gaps only on development if there is fresh scale-drift evidence; do not fit per-fold transformations on outer OOF labels. An outer-fold leave-one-out weight-fitting stress test can be diagnostic, but is **not fully nested validation**: other OOF models may have trained on the held fold's labels. Do not label it a fresh test or use it to claim unbiased gains.

If no candidate clears the registered gate, v2 should retain the exact v1 blend and report the negative campaign. The operationally strongest deliverable may be unchanged predictions with better verification. If some pass, publish v2 as a **development-selected extension of v1**, with its own hashes and the complete experiment ledger. No new unbiased audit score is available. A paired development bootstrap, if reported, is conditional on already-selected models/weights and does not capture adaptive recipe selection or retraining variation; it must not be presented as a confidence bound on the entire campaign's improvement.

## Pipeline checks and known limits

- Every real-data smoke must join frozen splits and filter `fold >= 0` **before sampling**, preprocessing, model fitting or validation. Synthetic fixtures remain preferable. Enforce the check in executable boundaries; comments alone failed in the earlier campaign.
- Explicitly retain IDs, target encoding 0/1, positive-class column, and source hash/seed/environment provenance. Reuse the existing Python 3.12, torch 2.14.1+cu130, PyTabKit 1.7.3, CatBoost 1.2.10, LightGBM 4.7.0 and XGBoost 3.4.1 environment. No dependency upgrades are needed for these slots.
- Numeric profiles fit on the supplied training rows only. They use 16 actual numerical measurements, not arbitrary numeric encodings of categorical strings. Training rows may contribute their own **features**, but never labels; this is not target leakage, although rare-group training/inference distributions can differ. Unknown routes use train-only fallback means.
- TE keeps inner shuffled KFold independent of y, train-only priors/maps and frozen smoothing. Unknown keys map to the training prior. During development selection, neither audit nor test may fit dictionaries, profiles, encodings or neural normalization. A post-freeze full-data production refit may fit these transformations on all supplied training rows; test features still cannot fit them.
- The same model seed is necessary for a matched comparison but not a guarantee of bitwise equivalence. Changed dimensions can change initialization streams; GPU arithmetic and stopping variability remain. Compare paired results, record this limit and avoid causal claims about one numerical mechanism beyond the changed configuration factor.
- OOF routes each row to one held-out fold model; the fallback averages fold models on every test row, while the intended final release blends fixed-length full-data refits. Neither pooled OOF nor macro-fold AUC directly scores either deployed function. v1's historical audit assessed its own released recipe; it cannot validate altered v2 weights, components or full-data refits.
- Current native neural artifacts support inference and completed-run recovery, not exact optimizer continuation. Do not resume changed hyperparameters from a previous checkpoint and describe it as a matched fresh run. Preserve incomplete runs separately; only complete ID-aligned three-fold candidates can enter blending.
- Before releasing v2, load every selected native checkpoint and persisted transform, exercise batch sizes 1 and a partial batch, verify CPU/CUDA tolerance where relevant, recompute the weighted blend independently and check exact sample-submission schema, row order, coverage, bounds and finite values. Do not overwrite v1 or upload/submit anything without separate authorization.

## Clock and resource budget

The current campaign config's limits are appropriate: stop launching exploration at **11:45 EDT / 15:45 UTC**, freeze selection at **12:00 EDT / 16:00 UTC**, deliver by **13:00 EDT / 17:00 UTC**. Launch only when measured remaining training plus inference/verification comfortably fits the cutoff. These 12 slots should consume roughly 40-75 minutes of training under prior timings, but implementation/debugging and representative verification can dominate; do not promise those estimates.

One GPU training process at a time. Keep RealMLP at eight members, batch 256 and four CPU threads; do not enlarge the ensemble or hidden widths in this pass. LightGBM uses CPU, preferably four threads when neural GPU work is active, but simultaneous jobs require a fresh available-RAM check on this 16 GB machine. Native categorical embeddings avoid full dense high-cardinality one-hot matrices; no proposal needs such a matrix. No remote paid compute.

Stop an experiment for invalid contracts, non-finite values, failed reload, OOM/resource contention or expiration of its stated cap, and preserve the last verified fallback. Do not kill a short neural run solely on its first-epoch AUC. When repeated matched changes yield no gate-passing blend contribution, stop that branch instead of widening the search because time remains.

## Research basis and inspection depth

- Reused the methods/evaluation and version/license review in `method_evidence.md`: [CatBoost, NeurIPS 2018](https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper/2018/file/14491b756b3a51daac41c24863285549-Paper.pdf), [LightGBM, NeurIPS 2017](https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper/2017/file/6449f44a102fde848669bdd9eb6b76fa-Paper.pdf), [RealMLP, corrected arXiv v3](https://arxiv.org/html/2407.04491v3), and [Cawley and Talbot's selection-bias analysis](https://jmlr.org/papers/volume11/cawley10a/cawley10a.pdf). No paper benchmark was reproduced in this design pass.
- Refreshed official [CatBoost tuning documentation](https://catboost.ai/docs/en/concepts/parameter-tuning), [LightGBM 4.7.0 parameter documentation](https://lightgbm.readthedocs.io/en/stable/Parameters.html) and [PyTabKit v1.7.3 interface source](https://github.com/dholzmueller/pytabkit/blob/v1.7.3/pytabkit/models/sklearn/sklearn_interfaces.py). The first attempted CatBoost common-parameter URL timed out; the tuning page opened successfully. Source inspection confirms numerical regularization/capacity controls, not their optimal values on this competition.
- LightGBM docs distinguish leaf-size/leaf-count regularization and note that feature filtering may depend on minimum leaf size; the proposed experiments use fresh dataset construction and do not recycle a Dataset across incompatible settings. PyTabKit's pinned interface explicitly supports categorical embedding size, and the local native wrapper admits the proposed fields. Installed/release versions and licenses remain those recorded by the first-pass audit; no new library is proposed.
- Community profile/teacher recipes remain hypothesis sources from `competition_evidence.md`. The local XGB profile gain and failed/mixed CatBoost transfer are stronger decision evidence than notebook titles or public-score claims. The separate source-research agent may supply new findings, but any new slot should replace a lower-priority one within this bounded budget rather than silently expanding it.

## Second-pass release review and executed synthetic checks

Reviewed `scripts/second_pass_release.py` and reported issues to its owner; this agent did not edit that implementation. The owner added immutable-anchor checks at every blend step, frozen-manifest membership/weight/configuration/path checks, complete native-artifact checksums for new cached members, raw-inference provenance checks, output-path isolation, seed-group collision checks, and strict CSV header/numeric validation. Coverage includes all three eligibility conditions, cumulative worst-fold loss against the immutable anchor, deterministic ties, fixed equal seed averaging and group-level gates, withholding incomplete groups, source-hash/config changes, freeze replay with forbidden data/config reads, historical-audit-field access sentinels, native-file change/removal/addition, manifest changes, protected v1 paths, raw CSV schema/IDs/numeric bounds, and verification hash failure. Mocked caches verify keyed rather than positional joins, arbitrary input indices, unchanged source frames, independent/disabled flags, fixed append order, float32 outputs for the 13 expected-rating values and one LightGBM teacher probability, and rejection of missing/duplicate IDs, nonfinite values and changed cache schemas. Expected ratings append after raw numeric category twins, so they are not accidentally recoded as additional high-cardinality categories.

These are synthetic regression and implementation-review results. The suite does not read competition data or audit labels/scores, run a learner, or establish real-model accuracy/native prediction equivalence. The selected release still requires the controller's actual full-data native reload and all-row raw inference comparison before publication. Remaining development-score limitations and the absence of an independent v2 audit are unchanged.
````

````markdown
# Local long-horizon registration, 2026-10-02

The user explicitly requested continued local and private-cloud training plus a much longer duration test. This authorizes one new local schedule contrast despite the previously closed short-horizon branches. This note registers the local experiment before fitting. No training was launched while preparing it.

## Exact contrast and isolation

- Campaign: `third_pass_batch05`; config `configs/third_pass_batch05.json`, SHA256 `cc6ae97f9234e8319f5863a071c3d2fd547c2cae5ebd05527d0ad6877df9e00d`.
- Candidate: `v3_realmlp_cat_raw_aux_e60`; control: completed `v2_realmlp_cat_raw_aux`.
- Copy the control exactly, changing only the ID, `max_rounds: 4 -> 60`, and operational `timeout_seconds: 1200 -> 3000`. Seed20261005, raw+original-EV features, native categorical twins, ensemble8, hidden[512,256,128], batch256, inference batch2048, LR.053, WD.015, four threads, and label smoothing0 remain identical. No source teacher, q probabilities, new seed, architecture, or learning-rate change.
- Preserve all53 previous batch03 run objects and the existing selection policy, comparison mapping, exclusion list and blend groups. Add the new candidate once. There are no cloud runs in this queue; pending/imported cloud LGB experiments stay in their separate campaign.
- Parent config `configs/third_pass_batch03.json` SHA256 `70af288ee50cbbb3c8f25c3e6492ed70e72f59b1dab3ab8d7b65fb8bfafbedd2`; control result SHA256 `92624c94d88f5967f0277cfda7350337eebbcaf295f1d821031663d4b1d090f1`.

## Nested training and interpretation

Existing `common.fit_model` passes `max_rounds` as `epochs`; the categorical RealMLP adapter accepts any positive integer horizon and sets `use_early_stopping=False`. All60 inner epochs therefore execute unless an operational timeout/failure intervenes. The checkpoint is selected by inner mean-ensemble ROC AUC only. Each outer model is freshly fitted on its outer-training partition for exactly that selected epoch count. All three frozen development folds must complete before a result can enter selection.

The existing schedule is normalized by total epochs. Changing the horizon changes the early learning-rate/regularization trajectory as well as extending training. # Third-pass preregistration and staged validation
````

````markdown
Prepared 2026-10-02 after the user's renewed authorization to train locally and on free private Kaggle compute and submit qualified releases until **13:00 America/Indianapolis, 17:00 UTC**. This supersedes the earlier recommendation to stop after v2. Exploration stops starting new work at **15:45 UTC**, unfinished exploratory fits stop by **16:00 UTC**, and 16:00-17:00 is reserved for frozen production refits, native verification and delivery. Qualified intermediate releases are permitted. A leaderboard return never changes weights, gates, candidate selection or this schedule.

This is a bounded research/protocol deliverable, reconciled with `THIRD_PASS_PLAN.md`, `configs/third_pass.json` and root's explicit registered decisions before initial fits. I inspected skills, project instructions, saved development metrics/configuration, native bank metadata, pinned implementation and cloud verification reports, and refreshed primary sources. I did not fit models, inspect audit labels/scores, score test predictions, edit shared configuration, upload data or submit. Root owns execution and integration. The initial local IDs and `original_aux_probability` flag below are registered; conditional branch IDs remain proposals requiring exact configuration/code hashes before fitting.

## Immutable evidence and anchor

Use all 629,671 development rows in the original three outer folds. Split SHA256: `4e262277b0a1494cd5d26ff45a30c827480ef334974f1331d730df0a7c80075c`. Never repartition in search of a better score. Neither the exposed original audit nor its historical sensitivity subset may influence selection, stopping, preprocessing, calibration or comparisons. Real-data smokes must filter `fold >= 0` before sampling. A private cloud training bundle contains only development labels; test/audit labels are not required for development jobs.

Treat **the entire frozen v2 blend as one fixed anchor**, including its old internal ratios and 50/50 seed group. Frozen manifest `artifacts/second_pass/blend/frozen.json`, created 12:48:50 UTC, SHA256 `d75c7eba29f8ed9cb3e9713e4f43b102a5d48dacdcfbba616f9c331a28bb0dc1`:

| Metric | Frozen v2 |
|---|---:|
| Pooled development AUC | 0.9613637193250886 |
| Mean outer-fold AUC | 0.9613677794358858 |
| Fold 0 | 0.9609059912494681 |
| Fold 1 | 0.9613022298978408 |
| Fold 2 | 0.9618951171603487 |

All comparisons remain adaptively selected development evidence. The previous 30 first-pass recipes, 17 second-pass primary recipes, confirmation and repeated blend grids already used these labels. Three correlated fold estimates do not support an independent confidence interval or a new unbiased generalization claim. Repeated public submissions add no permissible selection signal. Record public results separately as external observations only.

## The rating-distribution hypothesis and exact feature contract

The source hypothesis is the observed-category probability and summed-log feature in [goodpjw2008's Part4 auxiliary-task notebook](https://www.kaggle.com/code/goodpjw2008/s6e10-auxiliary-task-features-lb-0-96129), inspected in `research/second_pass_competition.md`. That source's transductive train+test banks and 16 targets are **not** our fitting scope. Its newly downloaded metadata did not expose a license, and an earlier notebook's Apache license does not establish this notebook's license. Attribute the mathematical idea and independently implement it; do not copy its code.

Reuse the 13 already frozen original-only XGBoost rating classifiers. Bank manifest SHA256: `4c0adfc0b94c5811d801cf058459159db3835d6bb8a0aa3a2029facc9c4d971c`. Their 129,859 cleaned original rows, vocabularies, 400-tree models and source-overlap exclusions remain fixed. Each bank omits its own rating from its 20 input predictors and never consumes satisfaction. Do not refit, recalibrate, change original exclusions or learn missing-value frequencies from development/test data. Remaining source ancestry and domain-shift risks persist despite exact-overlap removal.

For saved bank j, let p_j(c | x_-j) be its class probability. Define one fixed block:

1. Match observed rating r_j against that bank's explicit saved class-value array. For finite integer supported values, **q_j = p_j(r_j | x_-j), unchanged from native prediction even when below 1e-6**. For missing, fractional or unsupported observed ratings, q_j = 1e-6. Upstream raw-schema rejection of invalid infinities still applies. No ordinal interpolation, class-index arithmetic or data-dependent fallback. Supported q is not clipped.
2. Append q_0 through q_12 in the saved rating order as float32 continuous columns, then **S = sum_j log(max(q_j, 1e-6))**, reduced in float64 before casting to float32. Only the log argument is floored. S is bounded by approximately [-179.60164, 0]. Existing 13 EV features and their computation stay unchanged. q and S do not become categorical twins. Freeze the final feature names/order and categorical indices in metadata.
3. **Baggage handling, bank index 10, has classes [1,2,3,4,5], unlike the other banks' [0,1,2,3,4,5]. Its observed zero must use the floor.** Never index column zero as rating zero for this bank. Record unsupported/missing counts and supported probabilities below the log floor separately, without selecting a new epsilon from these counts. Root fixed this contract before cache construction. The canonical CPU cache logged 3,045 supported q values below 1e-6; their q features remain unchanged. An earlier draft of this note incorrectly floored q itself and is superseded by this correction, not by a retrospective feature change.
4. The observed rating is used only for selecting the probability after prediction; it must not enter its own bank's input. Features from these externally fitted banks can be cached for all rows because no synthetic satisfaction labels or synthetic-fit statistics enter them. Main-model transformations, categorical vocabulary, TE and route profiles remain fold-local.

Information rationale: equal predicted means can conceal different conditional distributions. Probabilities [.5,0,.5] and [0,1,0] on [0,1,2] both have expectation 1, but radically different probability for an observed 1. Raw rating plus EV cannot recover that distribution shape. This is a mechanism, not a measured gain. Rare categories, original-domain miscalibration and synthetic shift can instead make q misleading; the summed log feature can overemphasize unsupported zeros and correlated terms.

The sum of overlapping conditional logs is a **composite conditional score**, not a normalized joint likelihood, anomaly probability or causal quantity. [Varin, Reid and Firth (2011), sections 1-2](https://www3.stat.sinica.edu.tw/statistica/oldpdf/A21n11.pdf) define products of conditional/marginal components and explain dependence and misspecification. The paper supports this interpretation, not a satisfaction-classification gain. [VIME (NeurIPS 2020), sections 4.1 and 5](https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper/2020/file/7d97667a3e056acab9aaf653807b4a03-Paper.pdf) supplies broader precedent for feature-reconstruction information; its masked neural pretraining and semi-supervised experiments do not reproduce our bank recipe. Neither paper was experimentally reproduced here.

## Four initial configurations, two independent execution lanes

Run the local and cloud lanes concurrently after their implementation smokes. Within the local lane, retain one GPU trainer at a time. Use separate cloud run IDs and ledger; keep one T4 trainer until measured host-memory/process controls justify two independent fold workers. Do not select a GPU/device by its score.

| L2 `v3_xgb_route_te_teacher_profiles_aux_probability` | Clone completed local `v2_xgb_route_te_teacher_profiles_aux`; append only the identical q/S block. | Three nested outer folds; 600 seconds total fit cap. |
| C0 `v3_cloud_realmlp_raw_aux_e4` | Exact raw+EV RealMLP recipe in the fixed cloud image; max epochs 4. No q block. | Three nested folds; 1,800 seconds. Engineering/method control, excluded as an independent selectable blend addition. |

Clone all remaining defaults exactly. L2 preserves its seed 20261004, TE keys/five-fold KFold scheme, profiles, source teacher, XGBoost params, max-rounds and patience. Its known baseline pooled AUC is 0.9606809788399172; do not compare against the no-EV profile recipe and call that a q-only ablation.

C0 is intentionally a cloud-local matched control, not an extra lucky platform candidate. C1's causal comparison is C1 minus C0 within the same cloud stack, not C1 minus local v2. The cloud image has PyTabKit 1.7.3, Torch 2.10.0+cu128, NumPy 2.0.2 and sklearn 1.6.1; local Torch/NumPy/sklearn differ. Preserve the verified CUDA stack. Upload hash-checked canonical raw/EV inputs and frozen IDs/split assignments, then use the same saved train-only transforms/semantics. Do not recompute original EV features through a different XGBoost version and quietly accept changed float32 values. Even identical seeds and inputs do not promise identical trained predictions across platforms.

### What the epoch test means

The local raw+EV run chose [3,3,3] epochs from four, while its already completed second seed chose [4,3,4]. This neither proves convergence nor establishes undertraining. Our wrapper evaluates every epoch and selects its best mean-ensemble inner AUC; it does not terminate immediately on a decline. [Pinned PyTabKit 1.7.3 scheduling source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dholzmueller/pytabkit/v1.7.3/pytabkit/models/training/scheduling.py) sets progress to epoch/max_epochs. The `flat_anneal` LR is flat through 60% then cosine-decays; decay and dropout also depend on normalized progress. Thus 12 epochs changes the earlier update trajectory and regularization timing. The existing outer refit uses its selected epoch count as a new schedule horizon, rather than replaying the exact prefix of the longer inner schedule. Keep this behavior matched in both cloud recipes and report it as a pipeline limitation.

Do not change label smoothing, LR, architecture or schedule simultaneously, and do not call this a pure additional-updates experiment. [Holzmueller, Grinsztajn and Steinwart's RealMLP paper](https://arxiv.org/html/2407.04491v3), methods/regularization, motivates carefully specified pretrained defaults and training schedules. Our very short competition recipe differs substantially from that benchmark setting; the paper supplies no predicted gain from 4 to 12 epochs here.

## Nested fitting and acceptance rules

For each outer fold, split only its training rows into the existing 90% inner fit / 10% stopping set with stratification and `seed + fold`. Fit vocabularies, continuous transformations, target encoders and profiles on their permitted inner training scope. Select rounds from inner AUC only; refit on all outer training rows for exactly those rounds; predict only the held-out outer rows for development evaluation. Outer labels cannot select checkpoints. Log every selected round and model/config/input hash. OOF IDs must cover exactly the frozen development IDs once, with explicit fold identities and finite [0,1] probabilities.

Evaluate at declared stage boundaries, not after every available fold. Incomplete runs cannot become candidates; finish the three folds unless a resource/integrity failure or deadline makes this impossible. Save pooled AUC, three fold AUCs, macro mean, log loss, Brier and per-fold probability mean as diagnostics. Probability-scale drift is reported, not repaired by post-hoc outer-label calibration or rank transforms. Keep the existing pooled objective and paired fold safeguards.

At each stage, consider `p_new = (1-alpha)*p_current + alpha*p_candidate`, with alpha in **[.05,.10,.20,.30]** only. Positive weights sum to one. Require all of:

- Pooled and mean-fold AUC each improve **at least .00001** against the current accepted mixture.
- No individual fold loses more than **.00002** against that mixture.
- The resulting cumulative mixture also improves pooled and mean-fold scores against frozen v2, with no fold below frozen v2 by more than .00002.
- Valid native artifacts, source/config/input hashes, OOF identities and the required platform control are present. For C1 specifically, its standalone pooled **and** mean-fold gains against C0 must be nonnegative, and no paired fold may lose more than .00002. This prevents admission based solely on a fortuitous environment change.

Select the largest qualifying pooled improvement; ties within 1e-12 prefer lower alpha, then the fixed registration order. Each frozen-v2-anchored search admits at most **two selected new candidate units in its complete release**, including any fixed seed group as one unit. Do not compound this into two more additions to a previous v3 release: each new search starts with the unchanged v2 anchor and considers the eligible registered v3 pool. Every later report retains the fixed-v2 comparison. For another submission, additionally require at least .00001 pooled and mean-fold gain over the best previously submitted development blend, with no fold losing more than .00002. Already released snapshots remain immutable; do not rewrite a frozen recipe. A new candidate fit is not itself authorization to bypass the incremental upload gate.

These practical thresholds limit flexibility but are not significance tests. Do not relax them to keep hardware busy or respond to public scores. A standalone gain is neither necessary nor sufficient for a local blend addition; the blend gate tests its marginal contribution. Report the matched standalone change as the mechanistic evidence even when the candidate enters only for complementarity.

## Conditional second stage and one confirmation

Continue the authorized loop through the exploration window with a **bounded second batch of at most four configurations**, enabled only by the following saved development evidence and runtime forecast. Register enabled IDs and precise cloned configs before any fit. This is not an open hyperparameter sweep.

Compare its feature effect with already completed C1 in the same image. This combines the two supported changes without another local duplicate. Cap 3,000 seconds, and require the same nonnegative pooled/macro matched-cloud check. No 24-epoch or width/ensemble-size sweep follows a failed C1.

The stage-two maximum is four fits: q-only, the two CatBoost fits and one cloud interaction. If all branch predicates fail, spend remaining time on failure diagnosis, release verification and monitoring rather than arbitrary replacements. Continuing to work until the deadline does not require creating unsupported experiments. A newly discovered concrete hypothesis would require a separate recorded protocol amendment before results, not an implicit expansion.

Allow **one fixed confirmation fit globally**, selected after the enabled primary stages are complete, no later than 15:15 UTC if feasible. ## Release snapshots and operational cutoff

After a qualified stage, root may freeze a new manifest, preserve its exact weights/rounds/configs/source hashes, and refit admitted new members on all labeled training rows. **Full-data production fitting may then include former audit labels**, with no performance evaluation, checkpoint search or tuning using them. Production can run on the same cloud platform as its selected recipe and return native models for local inference; do not substitute a locally retrained cloud recipe without recording the platform change. Production rounds use the established deterministic median of its three inner-selected rounds, fixed before fitting.

Before each authorized submission: verify native checksums, feature-bank hashes, original-class lookup, unchanged supported q, missing/unseen fallback and floored-log reduction; regenerate every new member from raw test rows; independently recompute the weighted blend; verify exact sample IDs/order/schema, row count, finite bounds and final CSV hash; and archive an immutable release report. Apply the incremental development upload gate, actual competition submission allowance and once-per-unique-CSV-hash check. Preserve v1/v2 and every earlier verified snapshot. If a new package fails, keep the latest verified submission as the fallback instead of publishing a partially verified improvement.

No new experiment starts after 15:45 UTC. Stop unfinished exploration at 16:00 UTC and freeze the best fully verified development-qualified snapshot; spend the final hour on production, retrieval, all-row native proof and delivery by 17:00 UTC. Root's 15-minute monitor may stop/fix/restart only owned jobs within these deadlines, hash contracts and remaining budgets. Finalize monitoring only when the final release is verified and every project cloud session has completed or been cancelled.

## Evidence status and verification targets

Refreshed primary evidence: composite-likelihood definitions/misspecification; VIME reconstruction method and evaluation scope; RealMLP methodology and pinned scheduler/category code. Official [XGBoost prediction documentation](https://xgboost.readthedocs.io/en/stable/prediction.html) confirms multiclass probability matrix/shape semantics, but current docs are newer than installed local XGBoost 3.4.1 and cloud 3.2.0; freeze the tested native path rather than upgrading. Pinned PyTabKit is Apache-2.0; no new dependency is proposed. No paper benchmark was reproduced and no unobserved competition gain is claimed.

Before costly candidate fitting, root should require synthetic tests for nonconsecutive/permuted classes, the missing Baggage class 0, empty/partial/reordered batches, unsupported ratings, finite/floor/log bounds, own-target exclusion, continuous/category schema order, original cache parity, tampered manifests and native reload. Verify old recipes still produce identical features when the flag is absent. These are concrete new-contract checks, not a new broad test campaign.

Root reports L1's matched pooled gain +0.0000202118 and mean-fold gain +0.0000201035, with fold deltas [-0.000012338, +0.000077181, -0.0000045322]. Therefore the registered q-only branch's requirement for two positive folds fails. Do not weaken or replace that branch predicate. L1 nevertheless has valid marginal blend value: the registered 20% L1 / 80% frozen-v2 mixture reaches development AUC 0.961388124833, with positive changes in every fold. These numbers are root's completed development results, not independently recalculated by this review. Root separately enabled the existing CatBoost matched pair from XGB's two-positive-fold evidence and registered `configs/third_pass_batch02.json`.

The independent pre-dispatch cloud check passed for bundle SHA256 `a5eee31904c7700357a32f174130195f044b47d545dd77cd97579269d741bd96` and runtime SHA256 `b534194f99c10545a50ddd52a2a7e91bd60b2e39aefbb6df1bc4de38ba169235`:

Only development.parquet has a satisfaction field. No label values or scores were read for this check.
- The e4/e12 run dictionaries differ only in ID and maximum epochs. The fixed v2 source and CPU EV-cache contracts, per-partition transformations, nested stopping/refits and CPU inference were reviewed statically.

Source compilation, synthetic deadline expiry/re-arm checks and all preparation hashes passed. ### Fresh research and rejected smoothing branch

Its original-only neural teacher remains an inspected source-backed option, not a newly reported performance gain. A newer [Cleanliness-distribution notebook](https://www.kaggle.com/code/karttikjangid05/s6e10-does-the-cleanliness-difference-hold-up), last-run 13:16:11 UTC, was downloaded into a temporary directory and inspected without execution. SHA256 `bf362987f864c277ed95aa1101be474b714ed2f04c4022cec8e674efefe2fb6f`, zero saved outputs. It studies marginal train/test feature frequencies and explicitly does not fit a model. Its author-reported lack of a multiple-testing-corrected difference supplies no basis to drop or reweight Cleanliness in this campaign.

Do **not** restore label smoothing merely because it is a library default. The refreshed [RealMLP paper, Appendix B.5](https://arxiv.org/html/2407.04491v3) reports worse AUROC with smoothing under both tested stopping schemes and suggests flattening confident-region logits as one explanation. Its favorable smoothing result elsewhere concerns classification error. Our AUC-stopped, very short recipe differs from those experiments, but the primary evidence does not favor this proposed extra fit. No smoothing candidate is registered.

### Reserve: original-only neural satisfaction teacher

**Activation requires both** (a) the already registered CatBoost probability-feature pair produces no qualified incremental release under the unchanged upload gates and (b) at least **45 minutes of usable exploration budget** remain after allowing for cloud import, release engineering and production verification. With the 15:45 UTC no-new-experiment cutoff, this normally means activation no later than 15:00 UTC; resource forecasts may require earlier. Cloud/release correctness takes precedence. Record the dated amendment, exact bank and downstream configuration, source/data/code hashes and time caps before the first teacher fit. This note does not itself enqueue the bank or candidate.

The one reserve is a fixed **original-only native categorical RealMLP satisfaction teacher**, whose clipped logit is appended to the unchanged local raw+EV student. It is a distinct external learned decision function, not a q-only substitute, pseudo-labeling, retraining on the exposed audit or unrestricted distillation search.

| Component | Fixed preregistration if activated |
|---|---|
| External bank | Existing 129,859 cleaned original rows and prior exact-overlap exclusions; canonical 21 predictors and satisfaction labels from that original-only source. Numeric/category twins use the existing native transform; no synthetic/test vocabulary, TE, EV bank or other teacher as inputs. |
| Teacher fit | One seed **0**, exactly **8 epochs**, existing native RealMLP eight-member [512,256,128] architecture, batch256, LR.053, decay.015, flat_anneal, ls_eps=0.0 and all other current verified defaults. No stopping set or original/synthetic-score selection. Retain a training-only vocabulary, transform and native export. |
| Feature | `original_realmlp_teacher_logit`: clip the saved model's positive-class probability to [1e-6,1-1e-6], compute log(p/(1-p)) in float64, store float32. Use the same fixed rule and CPU native path for keyed cache and raw inference. Unknown categories follow the existing native sentinel contract. |
| Downstream candidate | Proposed `v3_realmlp_cat_raw_aux_original_nn_teacher`: clone completed `v2_realmlp_cat_raw_aux`, seed20261005/max4epochs, append only that one continuous teacher logit. No q/S, route profiles, TE, XGB/LGB teacher or new hyperparameter change. Full original three-fold nested development protocol. |
| Budget | Teacher fit plus complete keyed feature cache at most **600 seconds**; downstream three-fold run at most **1,200 seconds**. One source seed and one downstream recipe only. The caps are limits, not observed runtime promises. |
| Evaluation | Report matched standalone pooled/macro/per-fold effects, then use the existing frozen-v2 blend and incremental-upload gates, at most two selected units. No fresh audit, public-score decision, epsilon search or teacher-seed expansion. The single global confirmation20261022 is not renewed by this reserve. |

Source attribution: inspected Part5 cell 12 trains an original-only RealMLP teacher using three seeds and eight epochs; its downstream views combine it with an XGB teacher and other features. That is evidence for the method's existence, not an isolated teacher benefit. Our single-seed fixed flat_anneal implementation would be an independently specified adaptation using the existing Apache-2.0 PyTabKit wrapper; do not copy notebook code or infer a license from a different notebook. The source's whole-data category construction and synthetic evaluation are not imported.

Mechanism: a source-trained neural decision function can express interactions differently from the existing tree teachers and predicted-rating means, potentially adding complementary external supervision. Expected failure modes are source-to-synthetic shift, source-ancestry optimism, saturation with information already captured by EVs and the anchor, or unstable extreme logits. The existing source anti-overlap policy reduces exact duplication only. No observed result presently establishes this bank's marginal utility. On activation, perform synthetic schema/class/unknown-category tests and small development-only cache/native parity first; reuse the bank unchanged for outer folds and final inference. It must never be refit on synthetic satisfaction labels.
````

````json
{
  "id": "research_grid_uncertainty_v1",
  "scope": "Conditional simultaneous uncertainty over exactly the already registered 49-point block grid; no new weights, candidates, model fits, audit data or release selection.",
  "motivation": "Do not use the incumbent-v2 standard error for a different small reweighting contrast. Estimate each contrast's paired uncertainty and their joint dependence.",
  "base_protocol": "configs/research_pass_v1.json",
  "existing_grid_result": "artifacts/research_pass_v1/blend/diagnostics.json",
  "method": "Exact positive/negative AUC placements for the incumbent and each fixed grid score; covariance of paired placement differences. Draw a zero-mean multivariate Gaussian with that estimated covariance. Use the 95th percentile of maximum absolute standardized perturbation for an approximate simultaneous fixed-grid band.",
  "gaussian_draws": 20000,
  "seed": 20261003,
  "extra_outputs": [
    "Contrast-specific standard errors and conditional pointwise intervals for every existing grid point",
    "Simultaneous fixed-grid interval endpoints and their critical value",
    "Which existing grid point maximizes observed AUC plus each Gaussian perturbation, labeled perturbation selection frequency rather than probability of being the true optimum"
  ],
  "prohibited_claims": "This cannot account for historical model/anchor/recipe selection, training variance, cross-fold training dependence or distribution shift. It is not an independent generalization estimate, Bayesian posterior, exact finite-sample confidence band, new release gate or license to select another submission.",
  "resource_limit": "CPU only, at most two numerical threads and 2 GiB planned extra arrays. No precision refinement or additional weight grid."
}
````

````json
{
  "id": "research_pair_geometry_v1",
  "reason": "Explain how correlated accepted models repair and break ranking pairs, and why a tiny net AUC gain does not identify precise blend weights.",
  "scope": "Fixed accepted-model score comparisons only; no selection, new weight search, audit data, model fitting or release action.",
  "base_protocol": "configs/research_pass_v1.json",
  "comparisons": [
    {"reference": "incumbent", "comparator": "v2"},
    {"reference": "incumbent", "comparator": "trees_only"},
    {"reference": "incumbent", "comparator": "neural_only"},
    {"reference": "neural_half_trees_half", "comparator": "incumbent"}
  ],
  "computation": "Exact strict cross-class rank-discordance counts from all-row Kendall discordance minus within-positive and within-negative discordance. Require tie-free scores and brute-pair synthetic verification. Repaired/broken pair counts follow from discordance and signed AUC win-count difference.",
  "limit": "Pair counts are explanatory geometry, not independent sample size or confidence evidence. Rows, models, recipes and weights have already been adaptively reused."
}
````

````python
"""Stratified paired row-bootstrap extension to frozen-score AUC diagnostics.

This does not train, tune, select, refit, or assess audit/test predictions. All
comparators share exactly the same resampled rows in each replicate. Sorting is
cached; integer bootstrap counts give exact tied-pair AUC without re-sorting.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

from analysis_auc_uncertainty_v1 import ROOT, LIMITATION, sha256, verify_inputs
import numpy as np
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class WeightedAUC:
    order: np.ndarray
    starts: np.ndarray
    positive_sorted: np.ndarray

    @classmethod
    def prepare(cls, y: np.ndarray, score: np.ndarray) -> "WeightedAUC":
        y, score = np.asarray(y), np.asarray(score, dtype=np.float64)
        if (y.ndim != 1 or y.shape != score.shape or not np.isin(y, [0, 1]).all()
                or len(np.unique(y)) != 2 or not np.isfinite(score).all()):
            raise ValueError("Finite aligned scores and both binary classes required")
        order = np.argsort(score, kind="stable")
        sorted_scores = score[order]
        starts = np.r_[0, np.flatnonzero(sorted_scores[1:] != sorted_scores[:-1]) + 1]
        return cls(order, starts, (y[order] == 1))

    def calculate(self, counts: np.ndarray) -> float:
        counts = np.asarray(counts, dtype=np.float64)
        if (counts.shape != self.order.shape or not np.isfinite(counts).all()
                or (counts < 0).any()):
            raise ValueError("Finite nonnegative row counts required")
        ordered_counts = counts[self.order]
        positive = np.add.reduceat(ordered_counts * self.positive_sorted, self.starts)
        negative = np.add.reduceat(ordered_counts * ~self.positive_sorted, self.starts)
        denominator = positive.sum() * negative.sum()
        if denominator <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Positive bootstrap weight required in each class")
        negative_below = np.cumsum(negative) - 0.5 * negative
        return float(np.dot(positive, negative_below) / denominator)


def class_stratified_counts(y: np.ndarray, rng: np.random.Generator) -> np.ndarray:
    """Draw n_positive and n_negative rows separately with replacement."""
    result = np.zeros(len(y), dtype=np.int64)
    for label in (0, 1):
        indices = np.flatnonzero(y == label)
        if len(indices) == 0:
            raise ValueError("Both classes required")
        result[indices] = np.bincount(rng.integers(len(indices), size=len(indices)),
                                     minlength=len(indices))
    return result


def main() -> None:
    destination = ROOT / "artifacts/research_pass_v1/validation/paired_bootstrap.json"
    if destination.exists():
        raise FileExistsError("Preserve completed bootstrap diagnostic")
    before = ROOT / "artifacts/research_pass_v1/validation/paired_auc.json"
    original_hash = sha256(before)
    original = json.loads(before.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    started = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    with threadpool_limits(limits=2):
        y, folds, vectors, evidence = verify_inputs()
        prepared = {name: WeightedAUC.prepare(y, score) for name, score in vectors.items()}
        for name, structure in prepared.items():
            expected = original["metrics"][name]["pooled_auc"]
            if abs(structure.calculate(np.ones(len(y))) - expected) > 2e-14:
                raise ValueError("Weighted pair AUC cannot reproduce independent recorded metric")
        rng = np.random.default_rng(20261002)
        draws = {name: [] for name in vectors if name != "incumbent"}
        for iteration in range(200):
            counts = class_stratified_counts(y, rng)
            reference = prepared["incumbent"].calculate(counts)
            for name in draws:
                draws[name].append(reference - prepared[name].calculate(counts))
            if (iteration + 1) % 50 == 0:
                print(json.dumps({"completed_replicates": iteration + 1}), flush=True)
        comparisons = []
        for paired in original["comparisons"]:
            name = paired["comparator"]
            delta = np.asarray(draws[name])
            standard_error = float(delta.std(ddof=1))
            comparisons.append({
                "reference": "incumbent", "comparator": name,
                "difference_reference_minus_comparator": paired["difference_reference_minus_comparator"],
                "bootstrap_mean_difference": float(delta.mean()),
                "bootstrap_standard_error": standard_error,
                "placement_standard_error": paired["paired_standard_error"],
                "bootstrap_to_placement_se_ratio": standard_error / paired["paired_standard_error"],
                "descriptive_conditional_percentile_interval_95": np.quantile(delta, [.025, .975]).tolist(),
                "replicate_differences": delta.tolist(), "interval_interpretation": LIMITATION,
            })
    if sha256(before) != original_hash:
        raise ValueError("The original paired diagnostic changed during bootstrap")
    record = {"started_utc": started.isoformat(),
              "completed_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
              "seed": 20261002, "replicates": 200,
              "stratification": "Binary class, preserving the two observed class sample sizes",
              "pairing": "Exactly the same resampled row multiplicities for every score vector per replicate",
              "fold_policy": "Original fold labels retained; no resplitting/retraining; not fold-stratified",
              "approximation": "Only 200 replicates; percentile tails and bootstrap SE have Monte Carlo error",
              "interval_interpretation": LIMITATION, "comparisons": comparisons,
              "original_paired_diagnostic_sha256": original_hash,
              "input_verification": evidence, "no_weight_optimization": True,
              "script_sha256": sha256(Path(__file__)),
              "shared_diagnostic_script_sha256": sha256(Path(__file__).with_name("analysis_auc_uncertainty_v1.py")),
              "test_script_sha256": sha256(Path(__file__).with_name("test_analysis_auc_bootstrap_v1.py")),
              "invocation": [sys.executable, *sys.argv]}
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with destination.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(record, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")
    for result in comparisons:
        print(json.dumps({key: result[key] for key in (
            "comparator", "bootstrap_standard_error", "bootstrap_to_placement_se_ratio",
            "descriptive_conditional_percentile_interval_95")}), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
````

````python
"""Fixed-prediction paired AUC diagnostics. Never a release-selection command.

The descriptive intervals assume independent sampled rows conditional on the
already fitted and selected scores. They omit training, adaptive selection,
cross-fold training dependence, and distribution-shift uncertainty.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys

for _variable in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS",
                  "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS"):
    os.environ[_variable] = "2"

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.metrics import brier_score_loss, log_loss, roc_auc_score
from threadpoolctl import threadpool_limits

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
TARGET = "satisfaction"
EXPECTED_HASHES = {
    "DEEP_RESEARCH_PASS_PLAN.md": "a52374b99626aa31e539757990fa4e940c6a38916ecfee3f5965406b124f1ef1",
    "data/splits.parquet": "4e262277b0a1494cd5d26ff45a30c827480ef334974f1331d730df0a7c80075c",
    "artifacts/third_pass/blend/frozen.json": "bc773bb7a65a3357ac82f1553ebd852e0fc2773cf6683650dce5fcf5166b3311",
    "artifacts/second_pass/blend/frozen.json": "d75c7eba29f8ed9cb3e9713e4f43b102a5d48dacdcfbba616f9c331a28bb0dc1",
}
LIMITATION = (
    "Descriptive conditional interval for fixed scores under independent-row "
    "sampling; excludes model-training variance, overlapping-fold training "
    "dependence, all adaptive recipe/weight selection, and distribution shift. "
    "It is not a selection-adjusted confidence interval or a release gate."
)


def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    result = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(1 << 20), b""):
            result.update(chunk)
    return result.hexdigest()


def json_read(path: Path) -> dict:
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def placements(y: np.ndarray, score: np.ndarray) -> tuple[float, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return AUC and class-conditional pair win rates, with half-credit ties.

    Positive row i: mean_j h(score_i - score_j), j negative.
    Negative row j: mean_i h(score_i - score_j), i positive.
    Time O(n log n), memory O(n), without materializing n_pos*n_neg pairs.
    """
    y, score = np.asarray(y), np.asarray(score, dtype=np.float64)
    if y.ndim != 1 or score.ndim != 1 or y.shape != score.shape:
        raise ValueError("Labels and scores must be matching one-dimensional arrays")
    if not np.isin(y, [0, 1]).all() or not np.isfinite(score).all():
        raise ValueError("Labels must be binary and scores must be finite")
    positive, negative = score[y == 1], score[y == 0]
    if min(len(positive), len(negative)) < 2:
        raise ValueError("Each class needs at least two observations for sample variance")
    negative_sorted, positive_sorted = np.sort(negative), np.sort(positive)
    pos_left = np.searchsorted(negative_sorted, positive, side="left")
    pos_right = np.searchsorted(negative_sorted, positive, side="right")
    negative_below = (pos_left + pos_right) / (2.0 * len(negative))
    neg_left = np.searchsorted(positive_sorted, negative, side="left")
    neg_right = np.searchsorted(positive_sorted, negative, side="right")
    positive_above = 1.0 - (neg_left + neg_right) / (2.0 * len(positive))
    auc = float(negative_below.mean())
    if abs(auc - float(positive_above.mean())) > 2e-14:
        raise ValueError("Positive and negative pair accounting disagree")
    return auc, negative_below, positive_above


def paired_auc(y: np.ndarray, reference: np.ndarray, comparator: np.ndarray) -> dict:
    """Paired DeLong structural-component covariance and difference interval.

    Direct variance of placement differences avoids subtracting nearly equal
    variances when scores are strongly correlated. Sample covariance uses ddof=1.
    """
    ref_auc, ref_pos, ref_neg = placements(y, reference)
    cmp_auc, cmp_pos, cmp_neg = placements(y, comparator)
    m, n = len(ref_pos), len(ref_neg)
    covariance = (np.cov(np.stack([ref_pos, cmp_pos]), ddof=1) / m
                  + np.cov(np.stack([ref_neg, cmp_neg]), ddof=1) / n)
    difference = ref_auc - cmp_auc
    variance = float(np.var(ref_pos - cmp_pos, ddof=1) / m
                     + np.var(ref_neg - cmp_neg, ddof=1) / n)
    se = float(np.sqrt(variance))
    margin = 1.959963984540054 * se
    return {
        "reference_auc": ref_auc, "comparator_auc": cmp_auc,
        "difference_reference_minus_comparator": difference,
        "paired_standard_error": se,
        "descriptive_conditional_interval_95": [difference - margin, difference + margin],
        "paired_covariance": covariance.tolist(),
        "positive_rows": m, "negative_rows": n, "positive_negative_pairs": m * n,
        "interval_interpretation": LIMITATION,
    }


def metric_summary(y: np.ndarray, score: np.ndarray, folds: np.ndarray) -> dict:
    fold_values = [float(roc_auc_score(y[folds == fold], score[folds == fold]))
                   for fold in range(3)]
    return {"pooled_auc": float(roc_auc_score(y, score)), "fold_auc": fold_values,
            "mean_fold_auc": float(np.mean(fold_values)),
            "log_loss": float(log_loss(y, score, labels=[0, 1])),
            "brier": float(brier_score_loss(y, score)),
            "mean_probability": float(score.mean())}


def verify_inputs() -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, dict[str, np.ndarray], dict]:
    """Read only splits and accepted development OOF; no raw/audit/test files."""
    checked = {}
    for relative, expected in EXPECTED_HASHES.items():
        actual = sha256(ROOT / relative)
        if actual != expected:
            raise ValueError(f"Registered input hash changed: {relative}")
        checked[relative] = actual
    split = pd.read_parquet(ROOT / "data/splits.parquet", columns=["id", "fold"])
    split = split.loc[split.fold >= 0].copy()
    if len(split) != 629671 or not split.id.is_unique or set(split.fold) != {0, 1, 2}:
        raise ValueError("Frozen development identity is invalid")
    ids, folds = split.id.to_numpy(), split.fold.to_numpy()
    incumbent = json_read(ROOT / "artifacts/third_pass/blend/frozen.json")
    v2 = json_read(ROOT / "artifacts/second_pass/blend/frozen.json")
    for selection in (incumbent, v2):
        if selection["split_hash"] != checked["data/splits.parquet"]:
            raise ValueError("Selection split mismatch")
        weights = selection["weights"]
        if (any(not np.isfinite(w) or w <= 0 for w in weights.values())
                or abs(sum(weights.values()) - 1) > 1e-12):
            raise ValueError("Invalid frozen weights")
    if len(incumbent["weights"]) != 15 or not set(v2["weights"]).issubset(incumbent["weights"]):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected registered incumbent members")
    y = None
    current, previous = np.zeros(len(ids)), np.zeros(len(ids))
    family_scores = {family: np.zeros(len(ids))
                     for family in ("realmlp", "catboost", "lightgbm", "xgboost")}
    family_weights = dict.fromkeys(family_scores, 0.0)
    blocks, member_manifest = {}, []
    for name, weight in incumbent["weights"].items():
        directory = ROOT / "artifacts/runs" / name
        result_path = directory / "result.json"
        result_hash = sha256(result_path)
        if result_hash != incumbent["source_result_hashes"][name]:
            raise ValueError(f"Selected result changed: {name}")
        if name in v2["weights"] and result_hash != v2["source_result_hashes"][name]:
            raise ValueError(f"V2 result changed: {name}")
        result = json_read(result_path)
        contract_path = directory / "contract.json"
        if sha256(contract_path) != result["contract_hash"]:
            raise ValueError(f"Run contract changed: {name}")
        contract = json_read(contract_path)
        if (contract["run"] != result["run"] or result["id"] != name
                or contract["split_hash"] != checked["data/splits.parquet"]
                or result["split_hash"] != contract["split_hash"]):
            raise ValueError(f"Run identity mismatch: {name}")
        for source, expected in contract["code_hashes"].items():
            source_path = directory / "source" / source
            if sha256(source_path) != expected:
                raise ValueError(f"Recorded source changed: {name}/{source}")
        if sha256(directory / "source/requirements.lock.txt") != contract["environment_hash"]:
            raise ValueError(f"Recorded environment changed: {name}")
        oof_path = directory / "oof.parquet"
        oof_hash = sha256(oof_path)
        if oof_hash != result["artifacts"]["oof.parquet"]:
            raise ValueError(f"OOF bytes changed: {name}")
        frame = pd.read_parquet(oof_path, columns=["id", "fold", TARGET, "prediction"])
        if len(frame) != len(ids) or not frame.id.is_unique:
            raise ValueError(f"OOF duplicate/missing IDs: {name}")
        order = pd.Index(frame.id).get_indexer(ids)
        if (order < 0).any():
            raise ValueError(f"OOF missing development IDs: {name}")
        frame = frame.iloc[order]
        if not np.array_equal(frame.fold.to_numpy(), folds):
            raise ValueError(f"OOF fold mismatch: {name}")
        labels = frame[TARGET].to_numpy()
        if not np.isin(labels, [0, 1]).all():
            raise ValueError(f"OOF labels are not binary: {name}")
        if y is None:
            y = labels.astype(np.int8)
        elif not np.array_equal(labels, y):
            raise ValueError(f"OOF label mismatch: {name}")
        score = frame.prediction.to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)
        if not np.isfinite(score).all() or ((score < 0) | (score > 1)).any():
            raise ValueError(f"OOF probability violation: {name}")
        summary = metric_summary(y, score, folds)
        if (abs(summary["pooled_auc"] - result["oof_auc"]) > 2e-12
                or np.max(np.abs(np.asarray(summary["fold_auc"]) - result["fold_auc"])) > 2e-12):
            raise ValueError(f"Recorded AUC cannot be reproduced: {name}")
        family = result["family"]
        if family in {"realmlp", "realmlp_cat"}:
            family = "realmlp"
        if family not in family_scores:
            raise ValueError(f"Unexpected accepted model family: {family}")
        current += weight * score
        previous += v2["weights"].get(name, 0.0) * score
        family_scores[family] += weight * score
        family_weights[family] += weight
        if name in {"v3_realmlp_cat_raw_aux_probability", "v3_xgb_route_te_teacher_profiles_aux_probability"}:
            blocks[name] = score.copy()
        member_manifest.append({"id": name, "family": family, "weight": weight,
                                "run": result["run"], "metrics": summary,
                                "result_sha256": result_hash, "oof_sha256": oof_hash,
                                "contract_sha256": result["contract_hash"],
                                "source_hashes_verified": contract["code_hashes"]})
    if y is None:
        raise ValueError("No development labels loaded")
    for score, selection in ((current, incumbent), (previous, v2)):
        if abs(float(roc_auc_score(y, score)) - selection["oof_auc"]) > 2e-12:
            raise ValueError("Frozen ensemble AUC cannot be reproduced")
    score_vectors = {"incumbent": current, "frozen_v2": previous}
    for family, numerator in family_scores.items():
        denominator = 1.0 - family_weights[family]
        if denominator <= 0:
            raise ValueError("Cannot remove all ensemble mass")
        score_vectors[f"without_{family}"] = (current - numerator) / denominator
    if len(blocks) != 2:
        raise ValueError("Missing registered v3 blocks")
    score_vectors["equal_three_blocks"] = (previous + sum(blocks.values())) / 3.0
    evidence = {"registered_input_hashes": checked, "members": member_manifest,
                "family_weights": family_weights,
                "development_ids_sha256": hashlib.sha256(ids.tobytes()).hexdigest(),
                "development_labels_sha256": hashlib.sha256(y.tobytes()).hexdigest(),
                "development_folds_sha256": hashlib.sha256(folds.tobytes()).hexdigest(),
                "labels_obtained_only_from_verified_development_oof": True,
                "read_raw_train_audit_or_test": False}
    return y, folds, score_vectors, evidence


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path,
                        default=ROOT / "artifacts/research_pass_v1/validation/paired_auc.json")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    allowed = (ROOT / "artifacts/research_pass_v1/validation").resolve()
    destination = args.output.resolve()
    if not destination.is_relative_to(allowed):
        raise ValueError("Output must remain inside this isolated diagnostic directory")
    if destination.exists():
        raise FileExistsError("Preserve completed diagnostics; use a new output filename")
    with threadpool_limits(limits=2):
        y, folds, vectors, evidence = verify_inputs()
        summaries = {name: metric_summary(y, score, folds) for name, score in vectors.items()}
        comparisons = []
        for name, score in vectors.items():
            if name == "incumbent":
                continue
            item = paired_auc(y, vectors["incumbent"], score)
            item.update(reference="incumbent", comparator=name,
                        mean_fold_difference=(summaries["incumbent"]["mean_fold_auc"]
                                              - summaries[name]["mean_fold_auc"]))
            item["fold_comparisons"] = [
                {"fold": fold, **paired_auc(y[folds == fold], vectors["incumbent"][folds == fold],
                                          score[folds == fold])}
                for fold in range(3)]
            comparisons.append(item)
            print(json.dumps({key: item[key] for key in (
                "comparator", "difference_reference_minus_comparator", "paired_standard_error",
                "descriptive_conditional_interval_95")}), flush=True)
    record = {"created_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
              "analysis": "six preregistered fixed-score paired AUC comparisons",
              "interval_interpretation": LIMITATION, "input_verification": evidence,
              "metrics": summaries, "comparisons": comparisons,
              "bootstrap_executed": False, "no_weight_optimization": True,
              "script_sha256": sha256(Path(__file__)),
              "test_script_sha256": sha256(Path(__file__).with_name("test_analysis_auc_uncertainty_v1.py")),
              "invocation": [sys.executable, *sys.argv], "python": sys.version,
              "versions": {name: importlib.metadata.version(name)
                           for name in ("numpy", "pandas", "scikit-learn", "threadpoolctl")}}
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with destination.open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(record, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
````
